summary: Zed Pro free for 1 year + $10/month in AI token credits for verified university students. Includes unlimited edit predictions, real-time multiplayer collaboration, and all Zed Pro features.
claim_steps: Sign in with a GitHub account older than 30 days on the Zed education dashboard.
Share your valid and current university (.edu) email address for verification.
Once verified, Zed Pro is free for 12 months and $10/month in AI token credits are applied.
